description.en: A magnetite ore ground in closed circuit and upgraded by low-intensity magnetic drums; magnetite is recovered even in composites, so concentrate iron grade follows liberation and therefore the grind.
description.es: Una magnetita molida en circuito cerrado y concentrada en tambores magnéticos de baja intensidad; la magnetita se recupera incluso en mixtos, por lo que la ley de hierro sigue a la liberación y por tanto a la molienda.

question.en: How fine must magnetite be ground to reach a pellet-feed grade?
question.es: ¿Qué tan fina debe molerse la magnetita para alcanzar ley de pellet feed?

provenance: authored scenario; parameters inside cited ranges; not plant-calibrated

sources.breakage: Moly-Cop Tools energy-specific selection (alpha0 0.0091 t/kWh, alpha1 0.651, alpha2 2.5, d_crit 6514 µm) and its documented alternative breakage set (beta0 0.4, beta1 0.65, beta2 4.02); dossier section 1.4.
sources.crusher: Whiten classification K1 0.5 to 0.95 CSS, K2 1.7 to 3.5 CSS, K3 about 2.3; dossier section 1.3.
sources.cyclone: Plitt geometry ratios typical of mineral-processing cyclones; sharpness and underflow density authored; dossier section 2.
sources.magnetic: LIMS magnetite recovery above 98% and grade rising with finer grind (Muthaphuli 2014); dossier section 5.
sources.water: Process-water capacity per tonne of ore (pumping and thickener capacity), authored 5% above each case's nominal requirement; it is the water constraint of the operating-point optimizer.
sources.kpi: Each nominal KPI range carries its own source in kpi_sources: a published value or range where one was found, labelled authored where none was; they are plausibility gates, not predictions.

recovery_pct.en: Authored: no published range was found for this case type.
recovery_pct.es: De autor: no se encontró un rango publicado para este tipo de caso.

concentrate_grade.en: 64.9 and 69.0% Fe at 75 and 45 µm grinds of the Zandrivierspoort ore (Muthaphuli 2014, J. S. Afr. Inst. Min. Metall. 114(7)).
concentrate_grade.es: 64,9 y 69,0% Fe con molienda a 75 y 45 µm de la mena de Zandrivierspoort (Muthaphuli 2014, J. S. Afr. Inst. Min. Metall. 114(7)).

magnetite_recovery_pct.en: Authored: the cited rougher drums recover above 98% of the magnetite (Muthaphuli 2014); this is the rougher and cleaner total.
magnetite_recovery_pct.es: De autor: los tambores rougher citados recuperan sobre 98% de la magnetita (Muthaphuli 2014); este es el total de rougher y limpieza.
